entries.proposition: COHORT: 25 of 31 phase I patients had tissue for at least one IHC assessment of at least one gene. DATO. Per-gene n therefore varies and the WWOX analysis rests on a subset (n = 17 with pre-score <=150).
entries.snippet: Twenty-five of 31 patients who were initially entered on our decitabine phase I clinical trial [8] had sufficient tissue to permit at least one IHC assessment

entries.proposition: HETEROGENEITY: eleven tumour types across 25 patients (counts sum to 25, computed); median five prior regimens. DATO. No per-type WWOX analysis.
entries.snippet: Tumor types included cancers of the breast (four patients), kidney (three), head and neck (three, including one adenocystic carcinoma)

entries.snippet: Decitabine doses of 2.5, 5, or 10 mg/m2/day on days 1 to 5 and 8 to 12 each 4-week cycle or 15 or 20 mg/m2/day on days 1 to 5 each cycle were administered over 1 hour

entries.proposition: REAGENT: WWOX IHC used a commercial Abcam antibody at 1:100, not the Aldaz polyclonal; no catalogue number or clone is given. DATO from Table 4 caption; the WWOX row reads Abcam, Cambridge, MA, USA, 1:100.

entries.proposition: SCORING: one pathologist (MIN), intensity 0-3 x percent, 0-300. DATO. No second scorer, no agreement statistic, no statement of blinding to pre/post status (searched blind, kappa, observer: zero hits).
entries.snippet: Participating pathologist MIN scored staining intensity as 0 to 3+ and generated IHC scores of 0 to 300 by multiplying the percent of tumor cells staining by the staining intensity.
